limitations.ja: 対象方程式・境界条件・検証の範囲は解説章と各コードを確認してください。教育用例は汎用ソルバーの完成を意味しません。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。
limitations.en: See the chapter and implementation for equations, boundaries and checked scope. Educational examples are not complete general-purpose solvers. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound. This post-measurement reporting revision is not a numerical repair. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.

title.ja: Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差
title.en: Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error

summary.ja: 短い固定区間でBDF2・SDIRK2・倍分割適応法を、資格済みRadau/BDF参照と比較します。
summary.en: Compare BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling on a short fixed interval against qualified Radau and BDF references.

assumptions.ja: 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。
assumptions.en: A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs.

algorithm.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。
algorithm.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result.

validation.ja: 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。
validation.en: Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately.

limits.ja: 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。
limits.en: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

review.ja: 観測mainのモデル式・初期値・Jacobianを選択閲読。今回T=.4のみで、原論文全文・4e10の長時間計算や既存数値表の再現ではありません。
review.en: Read the model, initial values and Jacobian in selected official source sections. The observed main URL is not an immutable release pin. Our T = 0.4 scope does not reproduce the original paper, the long 4e10 benchmark or its numerical tables.

title.ja: van der Polの短時間剛性遷移
title.en: Van der Pol: an early stiffness transition

summary.ja: 局所制御と大域誤差を分離します。初回は元209目標中208達成で、μ=1の厳しい適応設定は大域目標2e-5に未達でした。
summary.en: Separate local control from global error. The first study met 208 of 209 original targets; the mu = 1 tight adaptive run missed the 2e-5 global goal.

assumptions.ja: x′=v,v′=μ(1−x²)v−x、初期値(2,0)、T=2。2方式×3刻み×2μと適応4runで計16run。
assumptions.en: The system is xprime = v and vprime = mu(1 - x squared)v - x, initially (2, 0), over T = 2. Two fixed methods, three step counts and two mu values plus four adaptive runs give 16 runs.

algorithm.ja: BDF2/SDIRK2と倍分割適応法。解析Jacobian・段階内だけの因子再利用・失敗時の候補保存を実装します。
algorithm.en: Use actual BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling, analytic Jacobians, factor reuse within each implicit stage, and retained candidates on failure.

validation.ja: 資格済みRadau/BDFと21時刻で比較。元の全判定を偽値も含め保存し、他208条件と、結果の忠実な表示・実局所制御・元失敗保存の3検証を別に要求します。
validation.en: Compare 21 sampled times with qualified Radau and BDF references. Preserve every original decision, including false values. Require the other 208 conditions separately from three checks of faithful disclosure, actual local controls and retained original failure evidence.

limits.ja: 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。
limits.en: This post-measurement reporting revision is not a numerical repair. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.
